title: 文化名称与解释性表达
goal: 能选择给定的文化名称，并用简短英语说明其特征。

points.label: 选择已给词表中的合适名称
用简短英语说明文化事物的特征

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 翻译教学所依据的大纲

body.p: 文化名称可以使用通行译名，也可保留拼音并补充简短解释。解释应说明事物的类别及主要特征。

body.box:
原文：粽子是一种用叶子包裹糯米制成的食物。
译文：Zongzi is a food made with glutinous rice wrapped in leaves.

body.p: zongzi 保留拼音；a food 给出类别，后面的短语说明材料和制作方式。

cards.title: 词汇表：节日
rows: a festival marking the lunar new year
a festival associated with dragon boat races
a festival associated with the autumn full moon
先给名称，再用说明写出节日的特征。

cards.title: 词汇表：饮食
rows: a food made with glutinous rice wrapped in leaves
dumplings made with dough and filling
a pastry traditionally eaten at the Mid-Autumn Festival
先给名称，再用说明写出材料或用途。

cards.title: 词汇表：工艺
rows: the craft of cutting designs from paper
the craft of decorating fabric with stitches
the craft of making objects from clay
先给名称，再用说明写出材料或技法。

cards.title: 词汇表：建筑
rows: a courtyard house with buildings around a courtyard
a small building used as a place to rest
先给名称，再用说明写出形制或用途。

body.box:
词表：四合院 siheyuan；亭子 pavilion；牌坊 paifang。
原文：四合院是一种房屋，建筑围绕庭院排列。
1. A siheyuan is a traditional ornamental gateway.
2. A siheyuan is a house with buildings around a courtyard.
3. A pavilion is a house with buildings around a courtyard.
4. A paifang is a place to rest beside a courtyard.

body.p: 词表中四合院对应 siheyuan。第二项保留房屋类别和围绕庭院的特征。

items.stem: 词表：春节 Spring Festival；端午节 Dragon Boat Festival；中秋节 Mid-Autumn Festival。原文：春节是农历新年。Which name is given for 春节?
items.why: 词表把春节对应为 Spring Festival，对应第一项。第四项是原文的解释，不是名称。

items.stem: 原文：剪纸是一种从纸上剪出图案的工艺。Which explanation keeps the category and method?
options: a craft of decorating paper with stitches
a craft of cutting designs from paper
a design printed on a sheet of paper
a craft of folding paper into shapes
items.why: 原文说剪纸是从纸上剪出图案的工艺。craft 说明类别，cutting designs from paper 说明技法，对应第二项。

items.stem: 词表：粽子 zongzi；饺子 jiaozi；月饼 mooncake。原文：月饼是一种糕点。Which name is given for 月饼?
items.why: 词表把月饼对应为 mooncake，对应第三项。第四项是原文的类别糕点，不是名称。

items.stem: 原文：四合院是一种建筑围绕庭院排列的房屋。Which explanation keeps the main feature?
options: a gateway standing in front of a courtyard
a small resting building inside a courtyard
a single house with a courtyard behind it
a house with buildings around a courtyard
items.why: 原文说四合院是建筑围绕庭院排列的房屋。house 表示类别，buildings around a courtyard 保留布局，对应第四项。

groups.text: 词表：剪纸 paper cutting；刺绣 embroidery；陶艺 pottery。原文：展览介绍剪纸和刺绣。剪纸从纸上剪出图案，刺绣用针线装饰织物。

items.stem: Which name corresponds to 刺绣 in the supplied list?
items.why: 词表把刺绣对应为 embroidery，对应第一项。

items.stem: Which explanation retains the material and method of paper cutting?
items.why: 原文说剪纸从纸上剪出图案。cutting designs from paper 保留了材料纸和剪出图案的动作，对应第二项。

items.stem: 词表：春节 Spring Festival；端午节 Dragon Boat Festival；中秋节 Mid-Autumn Festival。原文：中秋节与秋天的圆月有关。Which name is given for 中秋节?
items.why: 词表把中秋节对应为 Mid-Autumn Festival，对应第一项。第四项是原文提到的圆月，不是节日名称。

items.stem: 原文：刺绣是一种用针线装饰织物的工艺。Which explanation preserves the category and method?
options: a craft of cutting designs out of fabric
a craft of decorating fabric with stitches
a piece of fabric decorated with printed designs
a craft of making fabric with needles
items.why: 原文说刺绣用针线装饰织物。craft 表示类别，decorating fabric with stitches 说明技法，对应第二项。

items.stem: 词表：粽子 zongzi；饺子 jiaozi；月饼 mooncake。原文：粽子用叶子包裹糯米制成。Which name is given for 粽子?
items.why: 词表把粽子对应为 zongzi，对应第三项。第四项是原料糯米，不是名称。

items.stem: 原文：牌坊是一种传统的装饰性门楼。Which explanation retains the category and feature?
options: a traditional house around a courtyard
a traditional gateway built for defense
items.why: 原文说牌坊是传统的装饰性门楼。gateway 表示门楼，traditional ornamental 保留传统和装饰性两个特征，对应第四项。

items.stem: 词表：剪纸 paper cutting；刺绣 embroidery。原文：剪纸是从纸上剪出图案的工艺。Arrange the explanation.
items.why: 词表给出 paper cutting，后文保留纸和剪出图案的技法。

items.stem: 词表：四合院 siheyuan；牌坊 paifang。原文：四合院的建筑围绕庭院排列。Arrange the given translation.
items.why: 词表给出 siheyuan，arranged around a courtyard 表示围绕庭院排列。

items.stem: 词表：粽子 zongzi；饺子 jiaozi。原文：粽子是用叶子包裹糯米制成的食物。Zongzi is a food made with glutinous rice ___ leaves. Complete with wrapped in.
items.why: wrapped in leaves 表示用叶子包裹。

items.stem: 词表：剪纸 paper cutting；刺绣 embroidery。原文：剪纸是从纸上剪出图案的工艺。___ is the craft of cutting designs from paper. Complete with the name in the supplied list.
items.why: 词表将剪纸对应 paper cutting。
